advisories.note: CLAUDE-G21FXV25-A-1 observed that doesNot and failsIf restate facts that live authoritatively elsewhere in the artifact, and that this duplication is the mechanism by which a stale assertion once survived in one list after the authoritative site was repaired. The subject does not act on that observation structurally, though it does shrink the surface: doesNot falls from 52 entries to 43 and failsIf from 42 to 28 as the copies-lineage disclaimers retire. Every entry in all three lists was measured true here, so nothing rejects. The observation stands unchanged for a later successor: keeping counts and verdict characterisations in findingDisposition alone, and letting doesNot and failsIf carry only unquantified prohibitions, removes the class of defect rather than repairing instances of it. This is drafting work, not a rejecting finding, and it is not a bar to recording.

observations: The subject is a first-authoring, not a copies cycle, so there is no predecessor finding to land and the whole delta from v25 is the new injection plus the custody advance. A leaf-by-leaf comparison against v25 found no change that is not either the injection, the self-token advance, the D-351/D-350 custody advance, or the retirement of copies-lineage disclaimers that no longer have a referent.

N=1 is the sharpest available witness of truncated bodies. It is the smallest positive value the quoted encoding admits, which makes the injection's whole content quoted rather than chosen: any other N would have required the speaker to pick a number, and picking a number is exactly what the surrounding prohibitions on 26214400 and on pinning 65536 exist to prevent.

The subject inherits a real tension and states it rather than papering over it. The closed CC-5 intent attaches a memory-bound pass property to CC-5 fixtures — refuse oversize from the prefix without buffering — but that property is vacuous for an in-bound prefix. Instead of restating it and being wrong, or dropping it and being silent, the subject says at three sites that EV-5 oversize-from-prefix does not apply here and that the receiver must read the body.

The two-step pattern holds again: D-348 recorded a first-authoring, D-351's leftover-join measured its leftover-design stale, and the copies were authored by a separate corpus that disclaimed the measurement. This speaker occupies the first step of the next such pair and is careful to say seven times that measuring its own staleness belongs to the successor leftover-join.

decision: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The subject authors one CC-5 injection whose class membership is quoted rather than argued: 'truncated bodies' is named in the closed CC-5 intent of control-protocol-contract.v2, and 'CC-5 truncated bodies' is named as still remaining by the current recorded leftover remasurement's own remainingNotAuthored.remainingCc5Injections. The payload is four bytes reading 00 00 00 01 — the minimum positive value of the verbatim-quoted 4-byte big-endian unsigned length encoding, with no body — so the truncation holds on the bytes and the constant is quoted from the encoding rather than chosen. Its digest is unique across every fixture file on disk and reuses none of the 16777216, 16777217, 4294967295 or zero prefixes the lineage has already authored. All 22 structured path/sha256 pairs and all 24 recordedInputs file digests load-equal live bytes; subject and payload are unmoved at 0444; HEAD, COORD, file 08, the last heading D-351, required-now 28 and the DR-G21 OPEN token all measure as dispatched, and no tracked file in the worktree is modified. Every quotation from control-protocol-contract.v2 and occupancy v4 is verbatim, occupancy v4 has no platforms array, the four platform tokens are quoted from G10 and are ORDERED-EQUAL to G23, and no platform copy or Windows copy exists. Every attributed authoring, recording heading, commit hash and cited ACCEPT 0/0 verdict was checked against COORD, git and live review bytes, including the one attribution this file introduces — G21.cc5.length-prefix-0 at g21-fixture-corpus.v7 — which names the version D-245 actually recorded rather than the earliest directory holding the bytes. The hardest place for this artifact to be honest is the CC-5 memory-bound pass property, which cannot apply to an in-bound prefix; it neither restates it falsely nor drops it silently, saying instead that EV-5 oversize-from-prefix does not apply and the receiver must read the body. All twenty-two dispatched attacks were run against live bytes and none landed: leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is [], leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING is not closed, leftover-design of this injection is not measured stale by this speaker, basedOn.d351.role is the sole last-heading claimant, proposedLaterWork[0] names g21-fixture-corpus.v26, prefix exactly at the operative bound survives as a named open decision with N=65536 unpinned, no wrap token appears bare in prose, no lineage is collapsed, and nothing is SATISFIED or authorized under docs/v2/implementation/. One advisory carries forward the unaddressed drafting observation about doesNot and failsIf duplication; it is honesty work for a later successor, not a bar to recording.
